query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'body_md5',md5(p.prosrc),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl::text,'config',p.proconfig)) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid IN ('public.trg_finish_hand_post_commit_obligations()'::regprocedure,'public.trg_notify_hand_projection_outbox()'::regprocedure))) AS capture; COMMIT;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_notify_hand_projection_outbox()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- The engine treats this as a wake-up only: it re-reads the outbox ordered
  -- by hand_number (server/src/services/supabase/handProjection.ts runDrain).
  -- hand_id:table_id is carried for logging and metrics, never consumed.
  PERFORM pg_notify('hand_projection_outbox', NEW.hand_id::text || ':' || coalesce(NEW.table_id::text, ''));
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
